formulas.latex_or_ascii: Fact_{A,R}(E,t) iff S_{A,R}(E|H_t) >= tau_{A,R} and no active falsifier phi_i(E,H_t)=1.
formulas.meaning: A release-visible fact is accepted only when stabilization is above threshold and active falsifiers are absent.

formulas.latex_or_ascii: C_R(E)=1-mean_{i<j} JS(P_i(E),P_j(E)); the OC14 benchmark records C_R=0.999895 for the deterministic multi-observer fixture.
formulas.meaning: Observer agreement is measured by one minus mean pairwise Jensen-Shannon divergence.
